title: Decoding Dark Matter: Specialized Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Rare Concepts in Foundation Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability using Specialized Sparse Autoencoders (SSAEs). While it includes experiments on toxicity and gender bias to demonstrate the utility of its method, its primary purpose is introducing a technical interpretability tool rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
